message.content: {"draft":"Transpose-scale: load x tile, multiply by weight vector in FP32, store transposed. Cast once at store.","plan":"2D grid over (rows,width). Load x tile, load weight row, multiply in FP32, store to out[j,i]. Mask both dims.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _k(","    x_ptr, w_ptr, out_ptr, rows, width,","    BLOCK_I: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_J: tl.constexpr,","):","    pi = tl.program_id(0)","    pj = tl.program_id(1)","    i0 = pi * BLOCK_I","    j0 = pj * BLOCK_J","    i = i0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_I)","    j = j0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_J)","    im = i < rows","    jm = j < width","    xp = x_ptr + i[:, None] * width + j[None, :]","    x = tl.load(xp, mask=im[:, None] & jm[None, :], other=0.0)","    w = tl.load(w_ptr + j, mask=jm, other=0.0)","    r = x.to(tl.float32) * w.to(tl.float32)[None, :]","    op = out_ptr + j[:, None] * rows + i[None, :]","    tl.store(op, r, mask=jm[:, None] & im[None, :])","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and weight.is_cuda","    assert x.dtype == weight.dtype","    assert x.is_contiguous() and weight.is_contiguous()","    rows, width = x.shape","    out = torch.empty((width, rows), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    BI = 32","    BJ = 32","    grid = (triton.cdiv(rows, BI), triton.cdiv(width, BJ))","    _k[grid](x, weight, out, rows, width, BLOCK_I=BI, BLOCK_J=BJ)","    return out"]}
